t: Uganda became independent in 1962 as a quasi-federal state built around Buganda and the other Great Lakes kingdoms.
Obote abolished the kingdoms in 1967, and Idi Amin’s rule of 1971–1979 killed an estimated 100,000 or more people.
Yoweri Museveni, in power since 1986, restored order and growth and brought back the kingdoms as cultural institutions in 1993.
dyk: Rwandan exiles who fought in Museveni’s National Resistance Army, among them Paul Kagame, went on to lead the Rwandan Patriotic Front, which invaded Rwanda from Uganda in 1990.
ev: Uganda becomes independent on 9 October under Prime Minister Milton Obote
Troops under Idi Amin storm the Kabaka’s palace at Mengo
A republican constitution abolishes the kingdoms
Idi Amin seizes power in a military coup
Amin expels the country’s Asian community
Tanzanian forces and Ugandan exiles take Kampala and overthrow Amin
The National Resistance Army takes Kampala and Museveni becomes president
The kingdoms are restored as cultural institutions
